label: decision-model request gate with e2e, #21981 on e13971f5b6
why: #21981 replaces the scope and security gates with one call to the decisions API on gpt-6-luna, and changes the gate datasets. Gates/scope uses the key relevance, drops decline_language and has 37 items in place of 31. Gates/security keeps 30 items, with the CI item marked unsafe. Both datasets run through judge_request, three runs per item, and an item passes only when every run does. Full check with e2e on e13971f, with a clean tree. The assistant container ran the same commit against the local Designer stack and the app ttd/assistant-bench, with PREVIEW_CHECK_ENABLED off as in production. Every scored behavior matches the last baseline: gate_verdict 1.000 on Gates/scope and Gates/security, 1.000 on Planner/intake and Planner/spec, on Loop/traces 0.889 for gen_required_tools, 1.000 for gen_stopped_cleanly and 0.000 for gen_content_pairings, and 1.000 on bench_completed, bench_field_coverage, bench_order_integrity and bench_texts_bound. All four builds finished with success. The render check was off, so build.pages-render and build.entry-page-renders have no score and the run is adopted with --force, as the last baseline was. The judge is gpt-6.1-sol.
